what: A queued call printed nothing for over twenty minutes (twice); the first time the queue was held by a daemon that inherited the lock. A call's output is only shown when it ends, so a waiting caller cannot tell queued from building from hung.
cost: about fifty minutes of waiting across two calls
cause: one lock, no line saying who holds it or how many wait
workaround: did the reading and data work meanwhile
fix: the loop prints `waiting behind <branch> (<seconds> s)` every 30 s, unbuffered
